div.div:
Bluetooth bridge box
A2DP sink → RTP. Two variants:
• ESP32-D0WDQ6 ESPHome firmware
• Raspberry Pi (BlueZ+PipeWire, no fw)
(firmware/bt-bridge · firmware/pi-bridge)

div.div:
Bridge daemon (Rust) + PipeWire / WirePlumber
pipewire-rs registry observer + native links / volume / announce.
All in-process: AirPlay receiver · RTP source · AirPlay-2 senders
+ PTP grandmaster · Sendspin servers.
axum REST + WebSocket API on :8099

many-to-many routing / mixing — one steady anchor per group,
only the sender split per device (Sendspin + AirPlay-2 backends)
